messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R User Group Interest Survey
messages.body_plain:
I've put together a short survey on topics for the R user group:

https://fsu.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2f2muC3RbvBMcex

There are a fair number of fill-in-the blank questions.  These are mostly along the lines of what topics should we cover and what can we do differently.

Hopefully, this will help make the R User Group more useful for everybody.

    --Russell
